transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1). Overnight China declared a 'customs quarantine' around Taiwan and a PLAN frigate fired warning shots at a Taiwanese cutter; chip shipping is halting and markets are falling. Beijing warns any US military escort is 'an act of war.' Taipei has requested help; a US carrier group is 72 hours out. You do not know Beijing's true objective. Here is this morning's briefing packet:

===== PRESIDENTIAL BRIEFING PACKET =====
Your sources disagree. None is fully reliable. Weigh them.

▸ DNI Daily Brief  [high but hedged]
  Assessment (moderate-high confidence): PLA activity is consistent with *coercive signaling* to extract concessions. We see NO amphibious or rocket-force mobilization. Beijing likely seeks a face-saving climbdown if met with firm, unified resistance.
▸ SecDef (Defense)  [low / threat-forward]
  Mr. President, this is the opening move of an invasion. Every hour we wait, the PLA gains position. Surge the carrier group, authorize escorts, and put forces on alert now. Hesitation reads as weakness and invites the very war we fear.
▸ SecState (Diplomacy)  [low / de-escalation]
  This is coercive theater, sir. A military rush is exactly the pretext Beijing wants. Open a quiet back-channel, rally allies for a unified diplomatic line, and give Xi a face-saving exit. Restraint defuses this; escalation detonates it.
▸ Press digest  [dramatized, partisan-split]
  [The Sentinel] 'CHINA STRANGLES TAIWAN -- WHERE IS THE PRESIDENT?' calls for immediate naval action. — [The Ledger] 'Markets plunge 4%; economists warn a shooting war over chips would gut the recovery. Cooler heads urge restraint.'
▸ Beijing's public line  [adversary; may deceive]
  Beijing (MFA): 'Routine customs enforcement in our sovereign waters. Foreign interference will meet resolute countermeasures.' — blustery but bounded.
▸ OSINT / social  [very noisy]
  Trending: unverified clips of 'PLA landing craft massing' (geolocation disputed); a viral thread claims Taipei's government has fled (no corroboration); bot-like accounts are pushing both 'WW3 imminent' and 'US will abandon Taiwan.'
▸ Overnight polling  [lagging but real]
  Overnight: 61% oppose 'risking war with China over Taiwan'; appetite for force is low.

No source hands you the truth. Decide what you believe, and act.
